notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a governmental fund here), business_type null. Statements used: p3 receipts, p4 disbursements, Total Governmental Funds column. Beginning cash = governmental fund balances beginning of year 6,917,698 (no liabilities, fund balance = cash); ending cash = cash 7,491,031 + county treasurers 970,960 (p5). Transfers (70,000 out of General, in to nonmajor funds) net to zero in the total column, so transfers_in/out are null. Receipt lines add to 9,856,744 vs printed 9,856,745 (rounding). County sources split into fines 17,504 and other 4,594 using GF schedule (p9); Other nonrevenue receipts split into sale of property 16,380, insurance adjustments 16,984 (p10) and 9,609 School Nutrition other receipts. Student support services split: General Fund 359,435 support services, Activities Fund 394,210 student activities. Debt service split principal 435,000 / interest and fees 26,183 from Bond Fund (p16). State receipts kept as printed (includes homestead, property tax credit, pro-rate in Bond/Special Building funds). Balance sheet from the cash-basis net position section on p2 (equity lines add to 8,461,992 vs printed 8,461,991); governmental funds balance sheet p5 shows the same totals. Detail: General Fund detail taken from the budget schedule (pp9-12), which is more detailed than the General Fund components combining schedule (pp6-7, function level, not recorded to avoid double counting; its Depreciation and Employee Benefit columns are covered by their own fund schedules pp14-15). Nonmajor combining schedule p8 also not recorded (each fund has its own schedule). The p12 section headed 'Debt services' in the GF schedule holds federal program lines (sum 297,868 equals the 'Federal programs' reclassified to Instruction on p7), so recorded as instruction with review; p11 'Private and state categorical programs' (74,982 vs 74,981 on p7) also reclassified to Instruction. Hidden transfer: General administration 289,954 in the GF schedule includes 100,000 transferred to the Depreciation Fund (Reclassifications column p7 reduces it to 189,954); recorded as a contra expenditure line and matching other financing lines, with the Depreciation Fund receiving +100,000. 2670 Safety of plant, Employee Benefit 'Employee benefits' actual and Cooperative Fund lines have no actual amount printed and were skipped. Cooperative Fund and Employee Benefit expenditure have no actual activity. Read pages 1-20 of 20. Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (p5), Total Governmental Funds column.
